PLAN "12-Week General Fitness for Post-MI Client (Moderate Intensity) with Nutrition Plan" 
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Progress toward baseline strength with safe compound lifts integrated into Phase 2/3 under cardiac rehab constraints"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Intro & baseline conditioning + added strength work":
        warmup:
          walking 10 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Light cardio & mobility + end-range prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full-body circuit + safety focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive load + compound lifts":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          back_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 2x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_calf_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper & lower split emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core stability + strength finishers":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 each side rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Higher compound lift density within HR limits":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          back_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          deadlift 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Tempo & technique focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lower_back_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 55m "Strength finishers + mobility":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_scan 5 minutes

    # Phase 4 continues the progression and culminates with a 5K time-trial window
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 50m "5K time-trial prep block":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          brisk_walk_jog 2x400m jog/fast-walk segments (alternate 2 min jog/2 min walk) rpe 5 rest 2 minutes
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Tempo cadence & efficiency work":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          2x200m tempo jogs with 2 minutes walk between, rpe 6
        cooldown:
          lower_back_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 50m "5K time-trial execution window":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          1x2 mile (3200m) continuous time trial alternative: brisk walk/jog progression aiming submax pace with RPE 5–6
        cooldown:
          full_body_scan 5 minutes

NUTRITION PLAN (Cardiac Health Focus)
TYPE nutrition
VISIBILITY public

OBJECTIVE
  "Support heart-healthy nutrition to accompany moderate-intensity exercise, emphasize portion control, fiber, lean protein, healthy fats, and sodium moderation."

DAILY GUIDELINES
  - Calorie intake: moderate deficit to support gradual weight management if needed; target roughly 1800-2200 kcal/day adjusted to individual needs and physician guidance.
  - Macros: protein 1.2–1.6 g/kg bodyweight; fats 25–35% of total calories (emphasize unsaturated fats); carbs remainder, focusing on complex carbs.
  - Sodium: limit to 1500–2300 mg/day depending on medical advice; avoid added salt; prefer spices, herbs.
  - Fiber: 25–38 g/day.
  - Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day; adjust with exercise and climate.
  - Alcohol: if consumed, keep to moderate limits or avoid per doctor guidance.

MEAL PATTERN (per day)
  - Breakfast: high-quality protein + high-fiber carbs + healthy fat
  - Lunch: lean protein, vegetables, whole grains
  - Dinner: lean protein, vegetables, small portion of whole grains
  - Snacks: fruit, nuts (unsalted), yogurt, or veggie sticks with hummus

SAMPLE DAILY MEAL PLAN
  Breakfast
    - Oatmeal with berries and a scoop of protein powder; add ground flaxseed
  Lunch
    - Grilled chicken, quinoa, mixed vegetables; olive oil drizzle
  Snack
    - Apple + a handful of almonds
  Dinner
    - baked salmon, brown rice, steamed broccoli
  Optional evening snack
    - Low-fat yogurt or cottage cheese with fruit

NUTRITION INTERVENTIONS FOR CARDIAC HEALTH
  - Emphasize heart-healthy fats: extra-virgin olive oil, avocado, nuts (unsalted), fatty fish.
  - Prioritize lean proteins: fish, poultry, legumes, low-fat dairy.
  - Favor complex carbohydrates: whole grains, fruits, vegetables, legumes.
  - Limit saturated fats from red meats and full-fat dairy; avoid trans fats.
  - Monitor portion sizes to support weight goals and energy needs.
  - Include potassium-rich foods (if not on electrolyte restrictions): bananas, leafy greens, beans.
  - Monitor total caffeine intake; keep moderate.
  - Ensure consistent meal timing to support energy for workouts and recovery.

SUPPORTING STRATEGIES
  - Hydration reminders around workouts; replace electrolytes if sweating heavily.
  - Pre- and post-workout nutrition: small carb + protein within 1–2 hours after training (e.g., yogurt with fruit, or a small smoothie).
  - Salt substitutes and flavoring: use herbs, lemon, vinegar, spices to reduce sodium reliance.
  - Regular check-ins with clinician or dietitian to tailor plan.

SAFETY NOTES
  - All exercises constrained by HR target ~115 bpm; avoid Valsalva; avoid max lifts.
  - If chest pain, dizziness, undue shortness of breath occurs, stop and seek medical attention.
  - Coordinate any dietary changes with his cardiologist, especially in relation to medications like diuretics or anticoagulants.

HIIT CONSIDERATIONS
  - Can be introduced in Phase 3 only if medically cleared and HR targets can be monitored.
  - Protocol must be low-volume, moderate-to-light intensity intervals at or below 70% age-predicted Max HR (approx 115 bpm) not exceeding total 5–10 minutes of work per session initially, with ample warmup/cooldown.
  - Example safe integration within Phase 3 (to be pre-approved by clinician):
    - Warmup: 5 minutes easy cycling or walking
    - Intervals: 6 rounds of 15s work at light effort with 45s easy pace (RPE 4–5), total 2.5 minutes of work
    - Recovery: 60–90 seconds between intervals
    - Cooldown: 5 minutes easy cycling/walking
  - If signs of distress appear, terminate immediately and revert to steady-state cardio.

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots. Example: 3x10..12 rpe 5
- Sets come first: 3x10
- RPE after: rpe 5
- Rest: rest 60 seconds
